reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: GET handler is a Next.js App Router exported route (public API exception — browsers invoke it as the OAuth callback endpoint). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; entry point is an unauthenticated external HTTP request. Gate 3: src/app/auth/ is explicitly in scope and data leakage is listed as a key security concern. Code at L79 confirms raw Supabase AuthError.message is embedded in the redirect URL without sanitization. Attack path is concrete (replay expired PKCE code → observe error message in browser URL bar), but the actionability of the leaked Supabase state identifiers is uncertain — Phase 03 itself noted no stack traces or filesystem paths were confirmed, leaving impact ambiguous.
